family.evidence: Strong evidence of overlapping cohort/reanalysis, insufficient to distinguish SAME TRIAL from PARTIAL COHORT OVERLAP. Four shared authors (Yeh, Chung, Kang-Min Chen, Hsing-Hsia Chen); Tsou additionally in 2010. Same northern Taiwan lumbar surgery/GA population, BL40 GB34 HT7 P6, 2/100 Hz 4–7 mA 20 min and 2-cm nonmeridian sham. All three age means/SD identical (60.7±12.0,57.2±15.7,63.2±14.0). Sham arm n=30, sex 9/21, diagnoses 5/10/15, chronic disease 17/8/5/0, blood loss 477.7±459.1, opioid 21.6±13.1, button presses 47.4±39.7 and initial demand 92.8±109.1 identical. Differences: 2010 99 included/94 analyzed 33/30/31 versus 2011 99 eligible/90 randomized/analyzed 30 each; 4000 versus 3000 beds; 2010 preoperative and ward+1/+2h versus 2011 recovery+3/+4h; epidural versus explicit central-line IV PCA; active/control opioid 18.6±9.7/27.2±12.5 versus19.3±9.7/28.0±12.1. Recruitment calendar dates absent in both. Does not prove independent cohorts.
family.analysis_handling: Hold both publications from independent counting. Hold opioid family until author confirms patient overlap, route, analyzed denominators and authoritative numerical dataset. Preserve separate report values; never substitute numbers across publications.
